# Get today's date range (datetime) today_start = datetime.datetime.now().replace(hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0) today_end = datetime.datetime.now().replace(hour=23, minute=59, second=59, microsecond=999999) today_date = datetime.date.today() user = env.user
# 1. Search for SCHEDULED follow-ups for TODAY assigned to current user followup_domain = [ ('user_id', '=', user.id), ('status', '=', 'scheduled'), ('next_followup_date', '>=', today_start), ('next_followup_date', '<=', today_end) ] followups = env['lead.followup'].search(followup_domain) lead_ids = set(followups.mapped('lead_id').ids)
# 2. Search for leads where the main 'next_follow_up_date' field is TODAY employee_id = False if user.employee_id: employee_id = user.employee_id.id elif user.employee_ids: employee_id = user.employee_ids[0].id
domain_main = [('next_follow_up_date', '=', today_date)]
if employee_id: domain_main.extend(['|', ('lead_owner', '=', employee_id), ('tele_caller_id', '=', user.id)]) else: domain_main.append(('tele_caller_id', '=', user.id))
leads_main = env['leads.logic'].search(domain_main) lead_ids.update(leads_main.ids)
all_lead_ids = list(lead_ids) lead_count = len(all_lead_ids)
if lead_count > 0: action = { 'type': 'ir.actions.act_window', 'name': f"Today's Follow-ups ({lead_count})", 'res_model': 'leads.logic', 'view_mode': 'tree,form', 'domain': [('id', 'in', all_lead_ids)], 'target': 'current', 'context': env.context, } else: action = env.ref('custom_leads.action_leads_main_action').read()[0] action
